changes.description: Initial release of HyperSync.
Direct peer-to-peer file transfer.
End-to-end encryption for all transfers.
Added dark mode toggle in the navigation bar.
Refined spacing in hero sections across all pages for a tighter look.
Redesigned the changelog into a sleek timeline format.
Fixed an issue where large file transfers would stall at 99%.
Resolved a bug causing the layout to shift on mobile devices.
Added local transfer history to track past files.
Introduced a new system-synced light/dark theme toggle.
Improved the animation smoothness of the nearby devices scanner.
Fixed an ICE candidate gathering timeout on restrictive corporate networks.
Patched a memory leak when transferring hundreds of small files.
Introduced multiplexed streaming for 3x faster multi-file transfers.
Added native QR code scanning using the device camera.
Full support for folder drag-and-drop on desktop browsers.
Completely revamped the underlying WebRTC connection logic for higher reliability.
Redesigned the transfer progress UI with real-time speed graphs.
Resolved a critical issue where aggressive battery saving would drop connections.
Upgraded cryptographic algorithms for the peer-to-peer handshake.
Comprehensive audit and cleanup of development console logs.
Removed redundant imports and unused code across the overall project.
Performance optimizations for production readiness.
